summary:
Easy to use Android application in Kotlin using AR to showcase objects such as asteroids, stars, planets and more, all around the user. Communicates with a local server. 
It popularises the discovery of new space objects.
details:
An Android mobile application written in Kotlin that communicates with a local server written in Python.

The application has intuitive, straightforward UI/UX experience.

Gallery with saved previous finds, allowing users to check their collection.

Picture from a fits file and data show up after clicking on a found object in app.
